commandLine:

echo "ado_browse(\"code = 'Pub_CDW_BOND_UKCLOSE'\");" | ac_evalform - | ac_trigger_ado.sh -

else
  AC_REPDIR=/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/cdw/out ac_extract.sh -d $BusinessDate -c Pub_CDW_BOND_UKCLOSE -t 173000 -i
  AC_REPDIR=/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/ipv/out ac_blend_extract.sh -d $BusinessDate -t 173000 -i -k 7 Pub_IPV_BOND_UKCLOSE,Pub_IPV_BOND_UKCLOSE_ORIG,Pub_IPV_BOND_UKCLOSE_PREV
fi
